verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Privacy Mode (code not used for training) and OpenTelemetry Export (streaming usage data to a customer-run collector), plus extensive Admin/Analytics/AI Code Tracking APIs that collect usage metrics — but none of this evidence describes a setting or mechanism for an individual user to opt out of telemetry/usage tracking itself. Privacy Mode addresses training-data usage, not telemetry collection, and OTel Export is about exporting collected telemetry, not disabling it.
